in_sanskrit.name: Khokhar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black Soil
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khokhar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' which means 'black' and 'kharah' which means 'soil'. This name symbolizes the fertile and rich earth which nurtures and provides life.

in_hindi.name: Khokhar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Black Soil

in_tamil.name: Khokhar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Black Soil
in_tamil.long_meaning: Khokhar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' which means 'black' and 'kharah' which means 'soil'. This name symbolizes the fertile and rich earth which nurtures and provides life.

in_telugu.name: Khokhar
in_telugu.long_meaning: Khokhar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' which means 'black' and 'kharah' which means 'soil'. This name symbolizes the fertile and rich earth which nurtures and provides life.

in_marathi.name: Khokhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khokhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' which means 'black' and 'kharah' which means 'soil'. This name symbolizes the fertile and rich earth which nurtures and provides life.

in_bengali.name: Khokhar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Black Soil
in_bengali.long_meaning: Khokhar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krishna' which means 'black' and 'kharah' which means 'soil'. This name symbolizes the fertile and rich earth which nurtures and provides life.
